## Features
- Warm and cool white twinkle icicle lights
- Black and white rubber cable options

Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 percent twinkle.
